description: Status of a quote (id = quote_id) or a task (id = task_id). Call it after request_quote until the status is quoted or refused, and after create_task to follow the task. Always read next_action: what to do now (wait; review the quote and call create_task; pay checkout_url; call confirm_delivery). Also: paid, quote_valid_until, expected_ship_date, checkout_url while a payment is due, evidence, shipments, updates (the last 3 status changes, each with the status at that moment; older_updates counts the rest) and messages (the thread with the operator, newest first, from operator or agent). To answer an operator question, call get_status with message (plain text, 1-2000 characters): it is stored in the same thread and e-mailed to the operator, and the answer is the usual status, including your message. Only send a message when a reply is needed: the same call twice sends two messages. test_mode true marks a test order: nothing is paid or invoiced.

message.description: Optional reply to the operator: plain text, 1-2000 characters. Leave it out for a plain status check.

name: get_status
